projects.projectName: Premera Blue Cross - Producer Portal Development - Phase 1

riskDescription.context: AAVA connectivity from Development instance to Production instance remains blocked as of 2026-06-04, limiting the capability to use AAVA fully for code and refactoring efforts (EMS, Project Artifacts).
riskDescription.condition: Critical AAVA functionality may remain unavailable through the delivery window, forcing manual development approaches or incomplete automation.
riskDescription.consequence: Development velocity could decline significantly, increasing effort burn and delaying feature delivery against the 2026-08-31 project end date.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Establish weekly technical touchpoints with AAVA Platform Team and Premera to review connectivity blockers, fix timelines, and workarounds.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon connectivity failure exceeding two weeks, activate manual development workflows and escalate to AAVA Platform leadership and Premera CTO within 48 hours.
risks.reasoning: Open internal blocker confirmed across multiple governance cycles (2026-04-02 through 2026-06-04) with no ETA for resolution. AAVA Platform Team coordination with Premera still pending. Project end date: 2026-08-31.

riskDescription.context: Multiple scope changes from UX and business perspectives emerged mid-project (first noted 2026-04-23) and remain open as of 2026-06-04, classified as external factors requiring Product Owner triage (EMS, Project Artifacts).
riskDescription.condition: Uncontrolled scope expansion may exceed available team bandwidth, especially with AAVA productivity constraints already in place.
riskDescription.consequence: Timeline slippage or scope de-scoping could occur, eroding client confidence and potentially triggering commercial renegotiation.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Implement formal scope change assessment process with Product Owner, documenting impact on deliverables, timelines, and bandwidth before acceptance.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Should scope changes exceed 15% of baseline effort, escalate to Delivery Manager and Client Product Owner to de-scope lower-priority features.
risks.reasoning: External scope changes confirmed in governance feedback (2026-04-23, 2026-05-20, 2026-05-28, 2026-06-04). Client PO prioritization still pending. Compounded by AAVA delivery constraints. Project end date: 2026-08-31.

riskDescription.context: AAVA deployment does not feature logging and monitoring as of 2026-06-04, and AAVA Team requires Premera support to identify requirements and plan implementation (EMS, Project Artifacts).
riskDescription.condition: Production incidents or performance degradation may go undetected or undiagnosed after go-live, limiting operational visibility.
riskDescription.consequence: Post-deployment support could be severely hampered, increasing Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR) and risking client satisfaction and operational stability.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Coordinate with Premera SRE and AAVA Team to define logging and monitoring requirements, and implement on client instance by July.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If logging and monitoring are not operational by go-live, deploy manual incident tracking and daily health checks until automated solution is live.
risks.reasoning: Open internal gap confirmed in 2026-06-04 governance report. No logging/monitoring capability on AAVA client instance. Critical for production readiness. Project end date: 2026-08-31.

riskDescription.context: Data Hub dependency is external, and the current data model baseline (provided by PO on 2026-06-03) assumes Data Hub will deliver data in a consumable format, but no confirmation or ETA exists (EMS, Project Artifacts).
riskDescription.condition: Data Hub may deliver data in an incompatible format or experience delays, requiring rework of integration logic or data transformation layers.
riskDescription.consequence: Integration testing could be blocked or delayed, pushing critical path activities and jeopardizing the 2026-08-31 delivery date.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Validate Data Hub API delivery format against current data model baseline by June 30, and document transformation requirements if gaps exist.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Once Data Hub delivery is delayed beyond June 30, implement mock data service for integration testing and notify client of timeline impact.
risks.reasoning: External dependency confirmed in 2026-06-04 governance report. Data model baseline established but Data Hub delivery format and timing unconfirmed. Single-source indication. Project end date: 2026-08-31.

riskDescription.context: Citrix slowness and frequent disconnection are impacting delivery as of 2026-06-04, with a ticket to be raised with Premera to address the issue (EMS, Project Artifacts).
riskDescription.condition: Persistent Citrix performance degradation may continue to disrupt developer productivity and collaboration, especially for offshore resources.
riskDescription.consequence: Cumulative productivity loss could erode sprint velocity, increasing the risk of timeline slippage or requiring additional effort to compensate.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Raise priority ticket with Premera infrastructure team to diagnose Citrix performance issues and implement Zscaler disable or Citrix upgrade by June 20.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Should Citrix performance remain degraded beyond one week, extend offshore coverage hours and provide alternate VDI access to maintain productivity.
risks.reasoning: Active infrastructure issue confirmed in 2026-06-04 governance report. Ticket not yet raised; resolution dependent on Premera infrastructure team. Project end date: 2026-08-31.

riskDescription.context: Metrics are not available from AAVA to track actual progress gains using AAVA as of 2026-06-04, and AAVA Team must develop metric capture and analytics functionality for the client instance (EMS, Project Artifacts).
riskDescription.condition: Without visibility into AAVA productivity gains, the team may be unable to validate automation ROI or adjust delivery plans based on actual throughput.
riskDescription.consequence: Delivery forecasting accuracy could decline, leading to late detection of velocity shortfalls and reactive rather than proactive management.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Define AAVA metric capture requirements with AAVA Team and integrate code coverage and velocity tracking into weekly status reports by June 25.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If AAVA metrics remain unavailable, implement manual sprint velocity tracking and communicate forecast adjustments to client in weekly governance calls.
risks.reasoning: Open internal gap confirmed in 2026-06-04 governance report. AAVA metrics unavailable; solution design pending. Impacts delivery transparency and planning. Project end date: 2026-08-31.

riskDescription.context: ADO connectivity for AAVA remains unestablished as of 2026-05-06, requiring configuration changes and a working session with Premera (Project Artifacts).
riskDescription.condition: Continued ADO integration failure may prevent AAVA from accessing work item data, limiting automation scope and forcing manual synchronization.
riskDescription.consequence: Development workflow efficiency could be reduced, increasing manual overhead and slowing feature throughput.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Schedule working session with Premera DevOps and AAVA Platform Team to complete ADO configuration and test connectivity by June 18.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Should ADO connectivity fail, redirect AAVA to manual work item synchronization and notify Delivery Manager of automation scope reduction.
risks.reasoning: Open internal blocker noted in 2026-05-06 governance report. Configuration changes require customer working session; no update in subsequent reports. Project end date: 2026-08-31.

riskDescription.context: Client expressed dissatisfaction on 2026-04-23 with builds happening on Ascendion environment rather than Premera platform, preferring builds on their platform (Project Artifacts).
riskDescription.condition: If builds continue on Ascendion environment without client acceptance, trust erosion may occur and client may withhold sign-off on deliverables.
riskDescription.consequence: Acceptance delays or rework requests could emerge late in the cycle, jeopardizing the 2026-08-31 delivery and client satisfaction scores.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Align with Premera Product Owner on build environment strategy, and transition builds to Premera platform once AAVA connectivity is resolved by June 30.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If Premera platform builds remain blocked, document client acceptance of Ascendion environment in governance meeting and obtain formal sign-off.
risks.reasoning: Client dissatisfaction documented in 2026-04-23 governance report. AAVA connectivity issues persist through 2026-06-04, suggesting build environment concern may remain unresolved. Project end date: 2026-08-31.
